_readme: CSS-only per-site fixes, applied inside the proxied page by hostname. Add objects like { "match": "example.com", "css": "...", "note": "why" }. 'match' accepts 'example.com' (domain + subdomains), '*.example.com' (subdomains only), or '~text' (hostname contains text). These load live, so you can tune them on a running deployment without a rebuild.
